title: PRISM datasets
description: Data from the PRISM framework for detecting and mitigating cross-slice policy abuse in 5G network slicing. Code: github.com/Lakshmirnr/Sliceguard-PRISM-framework

datasets.name: Control-plane events
datasets.description: PCF and SMF events (PDU session establishment/modification, policy updates) with requested and authorized QoS and a ground-truth label. Sample rows are synthetic.

datasets.name: UE feature vectors
datasets.description: Per-UE, per-window features (f_mod, f_pcf, ΔQoS, f_slice, I_intent) with Mahalanobis risk score and flag. Sample rows are synthetic.

datasets.name: Slice intent profiles
datasets.description: Allowed 5QI, GFBR range and maximum ARP level for the eMBB, URLLC and mMTC slices. Example values.

datasets.name: Fairness and variance time series
datasets.description: Jain's fairness index, PCF policy variance and throughput variance over the 600 s run (Fig. 5). Headers only.

datasets.name: Detection delay vs attack rate
datasets.description: Detection delay against QoS modification rate (Fig. 6a). Headers only.

datasets.name: ROC curves
datasets.description: True/false positive rates for behavioral-only and behavioral + intent detection (Fig. 6b). Headers only.

datasets.name: Data dictionary
datasets.description: Column definitions and how each file maps to the paper's equations and figures.
